question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Abuse
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abuse"** means to use something to bad effect or for a bad purpose; misuse. It can also mean to treat someone with cruelty or violence, especially regularly or repeatedly. (दुरुपयोग, गाली देना)

 
 
• **Example: **She was accused of **abusing **her position to gain personal benefits.
 
 
 
• **"Applause" **refers to showing approval or praise by clapping hands. (तालियाँ)
 
 
• **Example: **The audience gave a thunderous **applause** after the incredible performance.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Abuse' **is **'Applause'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rebuke** (फटकारना): To express sharp disapproval or criticism of someone because of their behavior or actions.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher** rebuked** the student for being late to class.
 
 
 
• **Fester** (सड़ना): To become worse or more intense, especially through long-term neglect or indifference.
 
 
• **Example:** His resentment towards his colleague** festered** over the years.
 
 
 
• **Flowery** (फूलों से भरा): Using too many complicated words or phrases in speech or writing.
 
 
• **Example:** His **flowery** speech was hard to understand and seemed insincere.
 
 

34:Tbce,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
